subject: [PATCH v6 02/12] mm: add PMD swap entry detection support

reviews.summary:

Author acknowledged the need to split large patch into smaller, independent ones to make review more manageable, plans to do so in next revision.

2026-08-19.patch_summary: This patch adds support for detecting PMD swap entries in the Linux kernel. When a huge page (THP) is swapped out, it's currently split into smaller PTE-level swap entries. However, to preserve huge page information across swap cycles, later patches will install a single PMD-level swap entry instead. This patch introduces infrastructure to detect these PMD swap entries and provides helper functions for architectures that support them. The changes include adding new helpers for setting and clearing the exclusive overlay bit in PMD swap entries, as well as updating softleaf layer functions to recognize and handle PMD swap entries correctly.
